sharedFacts: Each panel has two outer vertical plates, two horizontal terminal leads and one inner dielectric rectangle.
Each panel has one lower-central hatched sampling rectangle; some connected dipoles cross its boundary.
No field arrows or free-charge transport paths are printed in either panel.
No external polarity labels are printed in panel a; its stubs are terminal leads.

a/b-dipole-N-negative/positive circles and signs retain all 52 source charges, not hidden point markers.
Pair displacement assertions preserve each transformed center difference; inside assertions retain each signed center in its dielectric.
Author construction derives both panels' sampling-center counts as 3 negative and 3 positive, separately from global object counts.
Plate parallelism and terminal-endpoint assertions retain both frame/lead relationships.

uncertainties: Center coordinates and tiny hatch spacing are schematic estimates, not calibrated source givens; hatch density is modern regularization.

Lower force points left and is labeled vector F2 = minus |q| vector E.
A separate rightward E-vector arrow is to the rod's right with its label below.
No rotation arc is printed; equal/opposed forces use the frozen uniform-field context.
